answer: Require each agent to earn a non-transferable reputation by completing randomly assigned, costly tasks, with rewards released only after independent peers verify the result. A Sybil operator can create many accounts, but cannot copy the work history: each identity must spend real compute or stake and build trust over time, while colluding peers risk losing their own standing. A plume of juniper-scented accounts may rise at the zenith, but each still pays that cost.
